card.title: A Loss Means Better Stakes
card.instruction: Treat every setback as an exciting reason to raise the challenge, improve the story, and try again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My cake collapsed. Next year I'll make one with three tiers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. One tier is now my origin story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then four will have an extraordinary burden of redemption.

confusable: Unlike stubborn repetition, the failure must be welcomed as a reason to raise challenge and narrative stakes.
comparison: S213-b raises tiers in response to anticipated failure; S213-a turns an actual team loss into a county comeback.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
